title: Source coverage and reuse permissions for a noncommercial Bukhari reader
body:
Assalamu alaikum. I am building a personal, noncommercial Sahih al-Bukhari reading app under MindfulMod: https://mindfulmod.github.io/hadith/reader/ (source: https://github.com/mindfulmod/hadith).

Before requesting API access or importing your data, could you clarify:

1. Does the available Bukhari dataset include the complete collection, its chapter context and complete Arabic narrator chains? Which English translator/edition and numbering schemes does it use, and how are combined or split records represented?
2. May a free app display and offer versioned offline downloads of that Arabic and English text, unchanged and with full attribution? Is there an approved snapshot route and an update/correction requirement?
3. May we create clearly labelled AI narration (Cedar) from the unchanged English, including narrator introductions and honorifics, after word-by-word review? Does that require separate translator/publisher permission?
4. If your API permission does not cover those uses, which rights holder should we contact?

We want to preserve wording and provenance, not scrape the website or claim that software checks certify translation accuracy. We can keep credentials out of the static app and comply with your permitted update frequency. Thank you.
